title: What If the Sun Were 20 Percent Dimmer? Early Earth Lived It

scenes.text: What if the Sun were a fifth dimmer? Earth would freeze, with one catch.
It isn't hypothetical. The young Sun delivered only 76 to 83 percent of today's energy.
With today's air and ice cover, Earth would sit in a continual deep freeze, with glaciers reaching the Equator.
Clouds and surface changes could supply only a quarter to half of the warming needed to prevent that.
The Sun has brightened since. Today it is about 1.4 times as bright as when Earth formed.
Yet there is no sign that early Earth froze. A far thicker greenhouse blanket must have kept it warm.

description:
What if the Sun were 20 percent dimmer?
The young Sun really was, and today's Earth would have frozen to the Equator. Something warmed the early planet.
What should we run through next?
